_comment: Observability floor for doctrine 6.6, read by obsgate.py.
Each surface names a metric family a later claim will lean on. The gate
answers WITNESSED / UNWITNESSED / FROZEN / INCONCLUSIVE against a live
Edit the patterns to YOUR metric names - the four surfaces below are the
floor, not the ceiling. Delete a surface only when you can say what claim
you are giving up the right to make.
max_label_cardinality is the route-template-never-raw-path rule made
mechanical: a `route` label carrying every distinct URL blows the cap and
is a memory bomb in the metrics store. Set the cap near your real route
_effects_comment: OPTIONAL. `surfaces` answers 'does the surface exist'. `effects` answers
the other half of 6.6: 'was the change I made actually WITNESSED there'.
obsgate.py snapshot --metrics http://svc/metrics --out before.json
...deploy / run the job / hit the new route...
obsgate.py snapshot --metrics http://svc/metrics --out after.json
obsgate.py effects --before before.json --after after.json \
--floor obs_floor.json
Exit 0 when every effect is witnessed, 1 when any is not (each named
with its DIRECTION - expected-increase-but-fell, expected-appear-but-
absent), 2 when the command cannot answer. Deleting this section does
NOT make `effects` pass: with nothing declared it refuses and exits 2,
because a vacuous 0 would be a tool certifying an unstated change.
The four kinds:
increased   the family's value sum strictly rose (optionally by at
least `min_delta`). A counter that FELL is reported as
COUNTER_RESET, not as a plain miss - a restart and an
absent effect need different fixes.
appeared    a family, or a specific label VALUE on a family, exists
now and did not before. Use it to prove a new route
template, tenant, or job type is actually instrumented.
Already-present is a MISS, not a pass: an effect that
cannot discriminate is the wrong declaration.
no_vanished_series
nothing that used to report has stopped. A vanished
metric is how a deleted instrument reads as zero traffic.
`allow` lists families you removed on purpose.
stable_labels
no label KEY appeared or disappeared on the family. A new
key multiplies the series count and silently re-partitions
every dashboard query built on it.
Delete the examples below and declare the effects YOUR change should
have. An effect nobody can name is a change nobody can prove happened.
